data.description:
## Description

**What**: Run a one-shot migration script: scan repo for # REVIEW-DEFENSE: comments (currently 154 instances); bind each to its file's primary owning ticket (most-recent epic story touching that file path); UNBOUND cases written to a Legacy REVIEW-DEFENSE corpus ticket; delete inline comments. In the same commit: remove reviewer-base.md REVIEW-DEFENSE Evaluation section; remove review-fix-dispatch.md inline-comment guidance; remove b6e9-6f1d G5-M1 pre-commit citation hook; update CLAUDE.md atomically.
**Why**: SC6 migration. Removes the in-band defense channel atomically once the structured store is operational.
**Scope**:
  IN:
  - Migration script extracts all 154 # REVIEW-DEFENSE: comments and writes records to TrackerDefenseStore (bound) or Legacy corpus ticket (UNBOUND)
  - All inline comments deleted in single atomic commit
  - reviewer-base.md REVIEW-DEFENSE Evaluation section removed (content-anchor)
  - review-fix-dispatch.md inline-comment guidance updated to bash-CLI DefenseStore writes
  - b6e9-6f1d G5-M1 pre-commit citation hook removed (no remaining target)
  - CLAUDE.md updated atomically
  - Cutover protocol communicated; both mechanisms honored pre-cutover, only DefenseStore post-cutover
  OUT:
  - DefenseStore tracker backend (S6)
  - Two-call architecture (S8)
  - GitHubPRDefenseStore (S12)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the codebase has zero inline # REVIEW-DEFENSE: comments, and all defenses are stored in the DefenseStore via TrackerDefenseStore or the Legacy REVIEW-DEFENSE corpus ticket
  ← Satisfies: "Migration via best-effort file-path binding, fixture-based validation, and forward telemetry"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Migration is one-shot; pre-cutover dual-mechanism period prevents in-flight resolution loop disruption
- [Maintainability] Audit log surfaces every extracted record and its target ticket

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a developer, my legacy inline # REVIEW-DEFENSE: comments are migrated to the structured DefenseStore in a single auditable commit
